hits.snippet: [/quote] Rogue like is all about randomness. hits.author: Shedletsky
hits.title: Gravity perks are inconsistent and worded strangely.
hits.snippet: In general this game could really benefit from better keywording and typing. For inspiration I think Slay the Spire and Magic: The Gathering do a good job at this. For example, there's a lot of abilities that are like "when target non leader ally is above an enemy non leader do 1 damage to surrounding cubes" when really it should say something like "when Over enemy minion Explode 1".

hits.author: Amorphis
hits.title: Love this game

The only suggestions I can make is add more events, enemies and variey of negative traits (which the devs will probably do anyway) and of course to add Professor George Edward Challenger as a playable character especially seeing this game features unexplored lands with dinosaurs.
